cast_roles.consequence: Loses control of the information she was hiding
Gains the fact he needs before payroll clears

scenes.causal_outcome: Levi can read the notice, so the next scene must produce a dated plan
scenes.consequential_choice: She gives up control of the notice instead of pulling it back
scenes.dramatic_purpose: Expose the immediate cost of concealment and force Mara's first honest choice in front of her partner
scenes.emotion_after: still afraid but no longer isolated
scenes.framing_movement_intention: Medium close-up on Mara inside the door, cut to Levi's hands, insert on the envelope, slow push to the exposed page
scenes.immediate_want: Mara wants one more vague promise accepted without reading the warning
scenes.lip_sync_intention: Spoken words in the first shots, sung line over a cutaway; intervals are expectations only
scenes.obstacle: Levi's empty ledger and his direct question block that escape
scenes.planned_dialogue_function: Spoken lines admit the concealment, then a sung line carries the admission without resolving it
scenes.sound_music_intention: Fan clicks off before the first line; quiet room tone, then a restrained low instrumental bed
scenes.time: evening closing time, one continuous evening
scenes.transition: Match-cut the shared ledger orientation into the next scene's first action
scenes.turn_trigger: Putting the open notice where Levi can read it shifts her from hiding to sharing
scenes.visible_action: Mara opens the envelope and places the warning beside the open ledger, then stops straightening the tools and leaves her hands still

cast_roles.consequence: Owns half the repair instead of waiting to be told
Accepts a written date she cannot quietly move

scenes.causal_outcome: A dated shortfall plan exists, so the CTA can be one concrete request
scenes.causal_predecessor: Levi can read the notice, so the next scene must produce a dated plan
scenes.consequential_choice: Mara writes the second date herself instead of dictating it
scenes.dramatic_purpose: Convert the exposed warning into a shared dated plan, so the solution answers the actual obstacle rather than reassuring
scenes.framing_movement_intention: Two-shot across the ledger, then over-shoulder to the written date, holding the established axis
scenes.immediate_want: Levi wants a date and a name against every unpaid line
scenes.lip_sync_intention: One spoken line mouth-visible, the repeated hook sung off camera; expectations only, unmeasured
scenes.obstacle: Mara wants the plan kept verbal so nothing is written down
scenes.planned_dialogue_function: Short spoken exchange sets the date; the sung hook names the open book once, deliberately repeated
scenes.sound_music_intention: Pen scratch and paper movement carry the beat; music drops to a single held note under the writing
scenes.time: evening closing time, minutes after the notice opens
scenes.transition: Hold on the written date and cut on the pen lifting to the single CTA
scenes.turn_trigger: Levi writes his own name first, so the plan costs him something too
scenes.visible_action: Levi writes the first supplier name and date in the ledger margin and slides the pen across the table without letting go of the page
